title: How to price your Niagara home to sell
excerpt: Why pricing is the most important decision you'll make as a seller, and how to get it right in today's Niagara market.
content:
Of every decision you make when selling, price has the biggest impact on how fast your home sells and how much you walk away with.

Why overpricing costs you

Buyers and their agents compare every listing against recent sales. A home priced well above the market gets fewer showings, sits longer and often needs price reductions, which can end up selling it for less than if it had been priced right from day one.

What really determines value

  • Comparable sales: similar homes nearby that sold recently
  • Active competition: what buyers can choose from right now
  • Condition and upgrades: kitchens, bathrooms, roof, windows and mechanicals
  • Location: street, lot, schools and commute

Why online estimates miss the mark

Automated valuations can't see your renovated kitchen or your busy street. A local comparative market analysis accounts for the details that buyers actually pay for.
